formulas.title: Harmonic Sum
formulas.desc: Σ aₙ(t) sin(2π n f t)

formulas.title: FM Sine
formulas.desc: sin(2π f_c t + I sin(2π f_m t))

formulas.title: Ocean / Wind
formulas.desc: noise → breathing LP filter (two slow LFOs)

formulas.title: Rain / Drops
formulas.desc: sparse resonant water drops over a soft noise bed

cards.title: Reaction
cards.desc: du/dt = Du·∇²u − uv² + f(1−u), dv/dt = Dv·∇²v + uv² − (f+k)v — the core growth engine.

cards.title: Field variation
cards.desc: Perturbs Feed/Kill spatially with two warped fbm layers — different regions land in different pattern families at once.

cards.title: Flow
cards.desc: Advects the field through a curl-noise velocity plus a constant drift ("gravity") — folded layers and drips.

cards.title: Palette
cards.desc: Maps the field to color with an iq-style cosine gradient, plus bump-mapped relief for a stone/glaze sheen.
